item.title: Moon in Aquarius: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Moon in Aquarius means the Moon was in Aquarius when you were born. In astrology the Moon stands for your inner world; Aquarius is an air sign ruled by Saturn, with Uranus as its modern ruler, fresh and independent. You feel deeply, from one thoughtful step away. Read more at astralroots.app
